items.title: Agentic AI Raises New Questions for Financial Institutions
items.summary:
DownloadDownload

Artificial intelligence (AI) has moved beyond answering questions and generating content. Increasingly, AI systems are being designed to act. Agentic AI can pursue objectives, make decisions and take actions on a user’s behalf, potentially with limited human involvement in individual decisions. [...] Consider a customer who gives an AI agent access to a bank account with an instruction to manage the customer’s cash efficiently. The agent decides to transfer funds, convert currencies or purchase an investment.

At first sight, these may appear to be ordinary customer transactions. Agentic AI, however, exposes important distinctions between identity, authentication, authority and attribution. [...] As agentic AI becomes more capable, firms may increasingly encounter interactions in which an AI agent collects information, compares products and initiates transactions for a customer. That creates a new layer between the institution and the person or entity with whom it has established a customer relationship.

items.summary:

[...] It identifies scaling as the engine of AI's advance, but also points to the growing cost and difficulty of obtaining training data as constraints on further progress.

The report likens AI's disruptive potential to that of the World Wide Web – without dwelling on the irony that the web itself is among the things being disrupted. items.title: IBM and Microsoft announce a new AI agent platform designed for industry-specific transformation - Source
items.summary: “Clients are no longer looking for AI that simply helps people do the same work a little faster. They want to build an agentic business,” said Mohamad Ali, Senior Vice President and Head of IBM Consulting. “Microsoft and IBM are helping organizations bring human expertise and digital labor together in a way that can scale across the enterprise, to turn AI from a productivity aid into a real competitive advantage.” [...] “AI is evolving quickly, and our focus at SEI is on applying it with intention in ways that strengthen trust, enhance human decision-making and create meaningful value across our business,” said Sneha Shah, Chief AI Strategist and Head of SEI Next. “Our work with IBM Consulting and Microsoft is helping us explore how emerging capabilities could support critical processes and be responsibly scaled over time, with the goal to create better experiences for our employees and clients. By combining [...] “Enterprise AI will be won by organizations that can turn their data, industry expertise and AI into action,” said Rodrigo Kede Lima, President, Microsoft Frontier Company. “Together, Microsoft and IBM Consulting are bringing the best of our technology and expertise, to help customers move from AI ambition to business impact faster and with confidence.”

items.title: Fall Staff Town Hall highlights ‘human-centered AI,’ community partnerships | Latest | NDWorks | University of Notre Dame
items.summary:
McGreevy highlighted Notre Dame's opportunities to use AI to advance research, particularly through the Data, AI, and Computing Initiative, led by Nitesh Chawla, the Frank M. Freimann Professor of Computer Science and Engineering and Lucy Family Director for AI & Academic Strategy, as well as the University’s growing strength in AI ethics, including the work of Meghan Sullivan, the Wilsey Family College Professor of Philosophy and founding director of the Institute for Ethics and the Common [...] From the staff perspective, Cullinan said AI presents opportunities to work more efficiently and better steward the University's resources. But those efforts would remain “human-centered," a dynamic he said might seem contradictory at other universities.

“Not at Notre Dame,” Cullinan said. “I think the most important asset that we have, and will have, is our people.” [...] “What will set our students apart is their competency in interpersonal skills: their ability to make moral judgments, to recognize injustice, and to work on addressing that," he said.

McGreevy echoed Father Dowd's characterization of a "bilingual" education, saying students should still be challenged even as AI makes some assignments easier.

items.title: He’s using AI to screen existing compounds for therapeutic potential | University of Pittsburgh
items.summary: Developing pharmaceuticals using AI isn’t new, but it is laborious and often leads to a dead end. “If you generate a brand-new molecule, that’s actually a limitation,” Wang said. “A lot of compounds can’t be synthesized, and that is a big issue.” [...] This back and forth is the GAN’s training. Over time, the generator learns to generate fingerprints that more closely resemble those of real molecules. Researchers then search chemical databases for existing compounds with similar footprints; the AI-generated pattern leads to the discovery of real molecules that researchers can test — no need to synthesize a new molecule. [...] In a paper published Oct. 28 in the journal Science Advances, Wang outlined Full-Spectrum Generative Lead Discovery (FSGLD), a novel, practical and reusable framework that takes advantage of generative AI to screen for existing compounds with potential for therapeutic development.

turns.assistant_text:
Bài viết trên Wikipedia về **Mô hình ngôn ngữ lớn (Large Language Model - LLM)** tóm tắt như sau:

- **Định nghĩa**: Mô hình ngôn ngữ lớn là một loại mô hình học máy, thường là mạng nơ-ron, được đào tạo trên một lượng lớn văn bản để thực hiện các nhiệm vụ xử lý ngôn ngữ tự nhiên, đặc biệt là sinh ngôn ngữ. LLM có khả năng tạo ra, tóm tắt, dịch và phân tích văn bản trong nhiều ngữ cảnh.

- **Ứng dụng**: LLM là nền tảng cho nhiều chatbot hiện đại như ChatGPT, Claude, và Gemini. Chúng thường dựa trên kiến trúc mạng nơ-ron transformer.

- **Cách hoạt động**: Các mô hình GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformers) là một loại LLM được đào tạo trước để dự đoán từ tiếp theo và thường được tinh chỉnh để tuân theo hướng dẫn và hoạt động như trợ lý.

- **Độ tin cậy**: Dữ liệu đào tạo thiên lệch hoặc không chính xác có thể làm giảm độ tin cậy của đầu ra từ LLM. Các đánh giá chuẩn cho LLM cố gắng đo lường khả năng lý luận, độ chính xác thực tế, sự phù hợp và an toàn.

- **Lịch sử**: Bài viết cũng đề cập đến lịch sử phát triển của LLM và các xu hướng trong đào tạo AI.

Bạn có thể đọc chi tiết hơn tại [đây](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model).

items.title: Large language model - Wikipedia
items.summary:
[Jump to content](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model#bodyContent)

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Type of machine learning model

"LLM" redirects here. For other uses, see [LLM (disambiguation)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LLM_(disambiguation) "LLM (disambiguation)").

[![](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/81/The_number_of_publications_about_Large_Language_Models_by_year.png/250px-The_number_of_publications_about_Large_Language_Models_by_year.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:The_number_of_publications_about_Large_Language_Models_by_year.png) The number of publications about large language models by year grouped by publication types

A **large language model** ( **LLM**) is a [machine learning model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning#Models "Machine learning") (typically a [neural network](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neural_network_(machine_learning) "Neural network (machine learning)")) trained on a vast amount of text for [natural language processing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_language_processing "Natural language processing") tasks, especially [language generation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Language_generation "Language generation"). LLMs can typically generate, summarize, translate, and analyze text in many contexts.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model#cite_note-few-shot-learners2-1) They are the basis for many modern [chatbots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chatbot "Chatbot"), such as [ChatGPT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ChatGPT "ChatGPT"), [Claude](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_(AI) "Claude (AI)"), [Vibe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mistral_Vibe "Mistral Vibe"), [Gemini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_Gemini "Google Gemini"), [Grok](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grok_(chatbot) "Grok (chatbot)"), [Qwen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qwen "Qwen") and [DeepSeek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepSeek_(chatbot) "DeepSeek (chatbot)").

LLMs are typically based on the [transformer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer_(deep_learning) "Transformer (deep learning)") neural network architecture.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model#cite_note-2) [Generative pre-trained transformers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_pre-trained_transformer "Generative pre-trained transformer") (GPTs) are a type of LLM that is pre-trained to predict the next word.[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model#cite_note-Wolfram-2023-3) GPTs are then often [fine-tuned](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fine-tuning_(deep_learning) "Fine-tuning (deep learning)") to follow instructions and to behave as assistants.[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model#cite_note-4)

Biased or inaccurate training data can make an LLM's output less reliable. A [software harness](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agent_harness "Agent harness") can provide LLMs with memory and access to tools such as web search. [Benchmark](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Language_model_benchmark "Language model benchmark") evaluations for LLMs attempt to measure [model reasoning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reasoning_model "Reasoning model"), factual accuracy, [alignment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AI_alignment "AI alignment"), and [safety](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AI_safety "AI safety").

**Tóm tắt về Mô hình ngôn ngữ lớn (Large Language Model - LLM)**:

- **Định nghĩa**: Mô hình ngôn ngữ lớn là một loại mô hình học máy, thường là mạng nơ-ron, được đào tạo trên một lượng lớn văn bản để thực hiện các nhiệm vụ xử lý ngôn ngữ tự nhiên, đặc biệt là sinh ngôn ngữ. LLM có khả năng tạo ra, tóm tắt, dịch và phân tích văn bản trong nhiều ngữ cảnh.

- **Ứng dụng**: LLM là nền tảng cho nhiều chatbot hiện đại như ChatGPT, Claude, và Gemini. Chúng thường dựa trên kiến trúc mạng nơ-ron transformer.

- **Cách hoạt động**: Các mô hình GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformers) là một loại LLM được đào tạo trước để dự đoán từ tiếp theo và thường được tinh chỉnh để tuân theo hướng dẫn và hoạt động như trợ lý.

- **Độ tin cậy**: Dữ liệu đào tạo thiên lệch hoặc không chính xác có thể làm giảm độ tin cậy của đầu ra từ LLM. Các đánh giá chuẩn cho LLM cố gắng đo lường khả năng lý luận, độ chính xác thực tế, sự phù hợp và an toàn.

- **Lịch sử**: Bài viết cũng đề cập đến lịch sử phát triển của LLM và các xu hướng trong đào tạo AI.

Bạn có thể đọc chi tiết hơn tại [đây](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model).
